item.title: How to layer Vitamin C without irritating your skin
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Start with a pea-sized amount in the morning, follow with moisturiser, and always finish with SPF. Less is more with active ingredients.

item.title: Finding your undertone: warm, cool or neutral?
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Look at your wrist veins in daylight: greenish means warm, bluish means cool, both means neutral. Then match a shade name, not a colour dot.

item.title: The 3-step morning routine that actually sticks
item.dc:creator: admin
item.content:encoded: Cleanse, treat, moisturise. Three steps, every morning, beats ten steps done once a week.
